auditor.independence: Auditor session f4f5a50c8316 (task role, lopdev lane move-working-set, manager 35c4f00e8d73). Translators were different runs: agent coder session 76c99189cb1d (job eacba7a3806e), jobs beaadf6c08ec and 9d716ec66066. First auditor was a different run: task session d11d211390f8 (instances d11d211390f8-pr1978-r2-*/r3-*); disclosure: this auditor saw its commit-message summary before starting and read its r3 findings after completing fr and es and before ru/vi/hi/ur/zh-CN; every finding marked concurs_with was re-checked against the committed bytes, and FR-S2-1, ES-S2-1, RU-S2-1, HI-S2-2 and ZH-S2-3 are new. scope: Full semantic pass of all 84 keys ui.mesh.mesh_actions.working_set_* plus ui.mesh.mesh_page.move_receipt_resumed (with its {retirement} clause ui.mesh.mesh_page.the_copy_here_is_gone substituted) against English, context, glossary, locale style guide and the existing locale corpus; safety meaning checked per the lane brief.

safety_checks.receiving_device: PASS — working_set_warning and working_set_checkbox name {device} (the destination) as the receiver of ALL working files (worktrees, unpushed commits, uncommitted changes, scratch files, session memory); the checkbox is a first-person consent that {device} should receive them.
safety_checks.keeping_device: PASS — working_set_warning_leave, working_set_warning_without, working_set_unknown and working_set_checkbox_leave say the files stay where they are and the conversation on {device} will not have them; working_set_kept_heading_on names {source}.
safety_checks.withheld_secrets: PASS — working_set_withheld_heading and the four withheld_* reason lines say the item is NOT sent because it looks like a secret (path, content, unpushed-commit path, unpushed-commit content); working_set_withheld_heading_stay avoids the double negative in files-stay mode.
safety_checks.refusal_remedies: FAIL on working_set_missing_tools (FR-S2-1): 'installez-les sur cet appareil' points to THIS (source) device. All reason_* remedies otherwise PASS ('sur celui-ci' anaphorically names l’autre appareil).
safety_checks.error_reassurance: PASS — working_set_error keeps 'the move asks you to review them before anything is sent'.

findings.problem: Wrong device. English 'install them there' means {device} (the destination). French '…; installez-les sur cet appareil avant de compiler ou de tester :' says THIS device: across this UI's fr corpus 'cet appareil' is the local device (49 values; ui.canvas.files.remotePeerUpdateHow contrasts 'sur cet appareil' with 'sur {device}'). The dialog runs on the source, so the remedy sends the reader to install tools on the machine the conversation is leaving. Identical defect was rated MAJOR and fixed in ui.chat.device_move.result.moved.second (receipt 564797e3-s3c-fr, D1, 'cet appareil-là').
findings.fix: 'Il manque sur {device} des outils dont ces projets ont besoin. Le déplacement fonctionne quand même ; installez-les sur {device} avant de compiler ou de tester :' (placeholder may repeat), or '…sur cet appareil-là…'.

findings.problem: Independently confirmed: with retirement ' ; la copie ici a disparu' the clitic 'y' in 'et la conversation y a repris' follows 'ici' and can bind to it.
findings.fix: '…{retirement}, et la conversation a repris sur {destination}.'

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes (script run by this auditor with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser, 84 keys x 7 locales, 0 issues): ICU parses; argument names/types identical to English; plural selectors are CLDR categories of the locale with 'other' present (fr/es one/many/other, ru one/few/many/other, hi/ur one/other, vi/zh-CN other); no bidi control characters; no ASCII '...'; trailing ':' kept on the four command-introducing lines; fr U+202F before : ; ! ? and U+2019 apostrophes; zh-CN uses '……' and no space between Han and Latin/digit runs.

Truncation: source-only. mesh-working-set.tsx and the confirm button in mesh-actions.tsx apply no nowrap/ellipsis to these headings/labels, so longer strings wrap rather than truncate (longest button: fr move_without 37 chars vs en 26). Rendered fit was not measured by this auditor; that evidence is the design stream's.
